content.short: Echelon is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless web3 game studios within the Web3 ecosystem on Ethereum and others.
content.description: Web3 gaming ecosystem powering competitive games. By leveraging the underlying security and performance of the Ethereum and Base and Solana network(s), Echelon aims to deliver a robust and scalable solution for its users. As the Web3 landscape continues to evolve, Echelon is positioning itself as a core infrastructure component to empower builders and end-users alike, bridging the gap between traditional architectures and decentralized networks.
